name: TWDB Volumetric & Sedimentation Surveys (completed surveys, GIS shapefile packages)
dataType: survey: sonar-derived contours (1/2/5ft), TIN, raster, elev-area-volume tables, PDF reports
geoCoverage: Texas (+ OK USACE lakes: Copan, Eufaula, Hugo, Hulah)
lakeCoverage: 123 survey directories, 203 shapefile zip links on index; 12 fleet lakes candidate-matched by name+state
format: shapefile zip, TIN, raster zip, PDF, TXT
access: HTTP GET of static files; index page is machine-parseable (href list)
license: Public; TWDB asks for acknowledgment; states maps not for navigation/fishing
reason: Real instrument surveys with multi-resolution contours; modern surveys (2009+) are high-density. Zips are large (20 MB - 1.8 GB each; Travis 2019 = 1.8 GB, Livingston 2019 = 1.3 GB).
notes: HEAD-verified sizes: Texoma 20.2MB, Eufaula 92MB, Canyon 209MB, Tawakoni 280MB, Conroe2020 352MB, Fork2009 528MB, Buchanan2019 631MB, CedarCreek2017 774MB, PossumKingdom2016 758MB, SamRayburn 779MB. Older surveys may need vertical-datum care; 'Recalculated' folders supersede some originals. Index parsed to /tmp only; re-fetch the index page to rebuild the lake list.

name: Minnesota DNR Lake Bathymetric Outlines, Contours, and DEM (REST MapServer water_lake_bathymetry)
dataType: contour (digitized from DNR lake maps) + 5/10 m DEM + survey metadata layer
lakeCoverage: 46,306 contour lines; 7,499 outlines; 1,305 lake survey-metadata polygons (about 1,900 lakes mapped per DNR); 10 fleet lakes candidate-matched by name+state
format: ArcGIS REST (JSON/GeoJSON); fgdb on Commons (download page now https://gis.data.mn.gov)
access: ArcGIS REST query (anonymous, paged); layer 0 contours, 1 outline, 2 metadata (fieldwork dates), 3 DEM raster
license: not verified (MN Geospatial Commons dataset; metadata at resources.gisdata.mn.gov/pub/gdrs/data/pub/us_mn_state_dnr/water_lake_bathymetry/metadata/metadata.html per search result)
reason: Scalable statewide dataset, directly fetched and downloaded. Contours were digitized from historical DNR lake maps (fieldwork dates in metadata layer) so quality varies by lake; units are negative feet. Some lakes are partially mapped (e.g. Rainy Lake contours only to -15 ft).
notes: Old direct file path resources.gisdata.mn.gov/.../water_lake_bathymetry/ returned 404; Commons moved to gis.data.mn.gov. The metc.state.mn.us FeatureServer mirror also works (45,982 contours).

name: Indiana DNR Lake Bathymetry (IndianaMap hosted FeatureServer)
dataType: contour polylines (field: contour, lake_max_depth, survey_date, lake_acres) + lake outlines
lakeCoverage: 10,260 contour lines in 146 name groups (5,034 lines have blank lake_name); 982 outlines; 2 fleet lakes candidate-matched by name+state
access: ArcGIS REST query (anonymous, paged); layer 0 contours, 1 outlines
license: No license stated; IN public data
reason: Real DNR survey contours with survey dates; blank lake_name rows must be resolved through finfo_lakeid/nhdid_waterbody/huc_12 before matching to the many IN reservoirs (Brookville, Mississinewa, Salamonie are not matched by name).

name: Montana FWP Hydrography - Lakes Bathymetry (layer 4)
dataType: contour polylines (field CONTOUR, SOURCE, AGENCY, LAKENAME)
lakeCoverage: 25,512 contour lines, 706 name groups; 6 fleet lakes candidate-matched by name+state
reason: Statewide; SOURCE/AGENCY attributes allow filtering to measured vs digitized. Includes Flathead (0-380 ft), Tiber, Hebgen, Georgetown.
notes: Canyon Ferry/Fort Peck/Holter not name-matched (Canyon Ferry name group differs: confirm). Unnamed lines exist.

name: Nebraska Game & Parks Lake Contours + Lake Shapes
dataType: contour polylines (Name, Depth, Elevation, Source); lake shapes with survey dates, volume tables, PDF map links
lakeCoverage: 6,143 contour lines, 155 name groups, 154 lake shapes (NGPC/USBR joint mapping program); 10 fleet lakes candidate-matched by name+state
format: ArcGIS REST FeatureServer; Hub CSV/GeoJSON downloads
reason: Instrument surveys (NGPC + Bureau of Reclamation) with survey dates; modern 3 ft / 5 ft intervals. Excellent validation source (McConaughy, Calamus, Merritt, Harlan County).
notes: Layer Lake_Shapes has SurveyDate, VolumeTabl, LakeMapPDF.

name: North Dakota Game & Fish Lake Contours (NDGISHUB)
org: ND Game & Fish / ND GIS Hub
dataType: contour polylines (CONTOUR, CONTOURINTERVAL, LAKE_NAME) + depth-range polygons
lakeCoverage: 4,765 contour lines in 236 name groups; 3 fleet lakes candidate-matched by name+state
reason: Statewide lake contour maps (feet); depth-range polygon layer 1 (4,781). Reservoir names carry suffixes such as 'Dam' or parenthetical aliases.

name: NH GRANIT / NHDES Bathymetry Lakes (lines & polygons)
org: NH Dept of Environmental Services + NH Fish & Game via NH GRANIT
dataType: contour lines (DEPTH ft, DATASOURCE, UPDATED) + depth-interval polygons
lakeCoverage: 9,285 lines, 7,351 polygons, 558 lake groups; 11 fleet lakes candidate-matched by name+state
format: ArcGIS REST (also FTP shapefile via GRANIT)
license: No access constraints; use at own risk; credit NHDES/NH F&G
reason: Surveys since 2000 mostly instrument-based; very good coverage of NH recreational lakes.

name: Washington Ecology Lake Bathymetry Contour Lines / Elevation Bands
dataType: contour lines (Depth ft, GNIS_Name, ReachCode) + polygon bands (layer 4)
lakeCoverage: 2,776 lines in 211 name groups; 2,632 band polygons; 4 fleet lakes candidate-matched by name+state
reason: Mostly digitized from 1960s USGS Water-Supply Bulletin 43 maps (coarse 5-100 ft intervals; Chelan 100 ft steps). Useful as sanity truth, weak for flats detail. Reservoirs such as Banks, Roosevelt, Riffe not name-matched.

name: Michigan DNR/IFR Inland Lake Contours (DNRHydrologyOPENDATA layer 1)
org: Michigan DNR Fisheries / Institute for Fisheries Research (UMich)
dataType: depth-band contour lines (MinDepth, MaxDepth) digitized from scanned historical lake maps
lakeCoverage: 25,492 lines, 1,482 name groups; 8 fleet lakes candidate-matched by name+state
reason: Historic map digitization (1930s+). CAUTION: some lakes carry only shallow bands (Higgins Lake and Torch Lake show 0-5 ft bands only although max depths are 130/250 ft per S-depth-022), so completeness must be checked per lake.

name: MassWildlife Inland Water Bathymetry (feature service)
dataType: contour lines (DEPTH, NAME, SHORE) from 1 m IDW rasters of GPS-sounder transects (+ older hand-drawn maps)
lakeCoverage: 27,989 lines in 264 name groups; 7 fleet lakes candidate-matched by name+state
format: ArcGIS REST; MassGIS also offers zip shapefile+TIFF
reason: Modern lakes are high-density transect surveys; older ones are 1950-70s hand maps. Quabbin/Wachusett/Sudbury layers also exist separately. MassGIS web page returned HTTP 403 to curl but the ArcGIS server works.

name: Kansas Biological Survey (KARS) Bathymetry Depth Contours (WaterResources/BathymetryContour)
org: Kansas Biological Survey, Univ. of Kansas / Kansas Water Office
dataType: contour polylines (CONTOUR depth ft) - NO lake name attribute
lakeCoverage: 7,667 contour lines; 0 fleet lakes candidate-matched by name+state; 12 more by location only
format: ArcGIS REST MapServer (no pagination; fetch by objectId)
reason: Single-beam sonar transects (100-150 m federal, 25-50 m state lakes). Lake identity must come from spatial join (no name field). KWO also posts newer multibeam surveys (Kanopolis, Fall River, Clinton 2025; Melvern 2026) on kwo.ks.gov/projects/bathymetric-survey (page seen via search only, not fetched).

name: FWC Bathymetry of Select Lakes in Florida (1-ft contours)
org: Florida FWC Fish and Wildlife Research Institute (data by ReMetrix, BioSonics)
dataType: 1-foot depth contours (DEPTHF, DEPTHM), no lake name attribute
lakeCoverage: 24,311 lines; 0 fleet lakes candidate-matched by name+state; 9 more by location only
license: Metadata: unrestricted, but 'should not be distributed'; keep internal
reason: Dense modern hydroacoustic surveys - best-in-class for Florida shallow lakes. Need spatial join for identity. Redistribution restriction noted; use for validation only.

name: OWRB Lakes of Oklahoma - Contours / Lake Points (LOK_Lakes MapServer)
dataType: contour polylines (lake, depth, elevation, source, year, datums) + lake points with depth_max/depth_mean/capacity (layer 0, 147 lakes)
lakeCoverage: 876 contour lines in 91 lakes (many municipal lakes); 147 lake points; 5 fleet lakes candidate-matched by name+state
reason: OWRB hydrographic surveys (acoustic + GPS) incl. Hudson, Murray, Sardis, Grand (2009). Large Corps lakes (Eufaula, Texoma, Kaw, Keystone, Oologah, Skiatook, Tenkiller, Broken Bow) are not in the contour layer; use TWDB for Eufaula/Texoma and OWRB PDF reports for others (https://owrb.ok.gov/studies/reports/ seen via search only).

name: Illinois DNR Lake Depth and Capacity (WaterResources MapServer)
org: Illinois DNR Office of Water Resources
dataType: contour polylines (CONTOUR) + 44 surveyed-lake polygons with volume, mean/max depth, survey date
lakeCoverage: 3,402 of 4,828 contour lines retrieved (server returned fewer ids than count); 43 of 44 lake polygons; 0 fleet lakes candidate-matched by name+state; 1 more by location only
reason: Small but high quality (IDNR 1990s-2010s sonar surveys); contours lack a lake name, join by location. Re-pull needed to get all 4,828 lines.
notes: Retrieval incomplete: ids query returned 3,402 vs reported 4,828.

name: WV DNR Public Fishing Lake Contours

lakeCoverage: 179 points; ~1 fleet lake

name: USGS ScienceBase per-reservoir bathymetry data releases (harvested catalog)
org: USGS Water Science Centers (cooperators incl. USACE, state DNRs)
dataType: survey: point soundings, DEMs, contours, elevation-area-capacity tables per reservoir
geoCoverage: USA (AR, MO, OK, KY, IN, ID, UT, MT, NV, WA, NY, CA...)

lakeCoverage: 9 zips; 6 fleet lakes candidate-matched by name+state

reason: Real sonar point depths: ideal for interpolation tests.
